newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - November 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - November 8.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Friday's edition of Daily Variety:

WASHINGTON - The Federal Communications Commission proposed dramatic changes to its television ownership rules that could lead to further consolidation within the industry as well as give television station owners even more power when it comes to dealing with Hollywood program suppliers.
WASHINGTON - Distilled Spirits Council of the United States officially ended its 60-year-old voluntary ban on radio and television advertising.
HOLLYWOOD - MGM Inc has created a company-wide promotions department to develop tie-ins for every division of the company.
